title: Loyal bank customer, rep trashes the bank
scenario: Long-time customer of a regional bank plans to get her purchase loan there. The rep disparages the bank and quotes a rate to win her over.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Mireille? This is Kofi from Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Speaking. What's this about?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: You requested info on a purchase loan, I think you're under contract on a condo?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Not under contract yet, but close. We made an offer yesterday.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Exciting. Have you gotten pre-approved anywhere yet?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Not formally. To be honest I'll probably just go with my bank. I've been with them twenty years.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I get it, but honestly, banks like that are slow and they bury you in fees. Most of my clients regret going with their bank.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hm. I've never had a problem with them.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sure, for checking accounts. Mortgages are a different animal. We could probably get you around five and seven-eighths.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Is that a real number or a teaser?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It would depend on your full file, of course.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Right. Well, my bank gives me a relationship discount, so I'm inclined to stay put.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood. What's the purchase price on the condo?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Two-eighty-five.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And how much are you putting down?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Twenty percent.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a great position to be in. Would you be open to letting us put a competing estimate together so you can compare side by side?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Maybe. Just email me something in writing and I'll look at it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I can do that. What's the best email?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: The one on the form is fine.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. I'll get that over today.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks.
